title: HALO LFS inventory
description: An inventory of the paths one vendored subtree declares as Git LFS at the pinned commit. It is not a fetch: `object_verified` stays false unless the payload was pulled into `upstream-cache/`, never into `vendor/`.

tracked.description: One record per path `git lfs ls-files <commit>` reports. Empty is a legal inventory: a commit that tracks no LFS objects has nothing to verify, and the declared `.gitattributes` lines below still record why.

pointer_verified.description: True only after `parsePointer` accepted the vendored bytes and their oid/size matched this record.

object_verified.description: True only when the payload exists under `upstream-cache/` and its SHA-256 equals `oid`. A payload inside `vendor/` is a finding, never a verification.

upstream_gitattributes_lfs_lines.description: The LFS-declaring lines of the upstream `.gitattributes` at the pinned commit, verbatim. Copied rather than re-parsed, so a change upstream is visible as a byte difference.
